observed_operational_fact: The first prompt produced 9,306 strict successes from 9,317 events after two cleanup passes. Eleven events repeatedly violated the cross-field target-specific/materiality rule.
rule: Do not coerce invalid outputs and do not retry to outcome-select a valid label. The common analysis population is the intersection of strict successful rows across all five prompts. Remove every non-intersection event from every prompt and from both existing-scorer comparators before reading returns.
failure_action: If the five-prompt intersection retains less than 99 percent, any company disappears, or either analysis year is empty, stop before returns.
scientific_reason: Strict complete-case analysis prevents prompt-specific missingness from changing activity or comparator exposure and avoids converting invalid model output into a usable score.
unchanged: 19 dollar operational and 20 dollar authorised spend limits
